operations: create/replace/cleanup/delete confirmed in one native session
exclusion: live helper, live owner after helper kill and wrong generation rejected
orphan: dead owner with live helper rejected; both exited permits inspection
interruptedPublisher: first write intent preserved; second source untouched; backup and coordination lock retained
inspection: cannot write source; original generation preserved
explicitResolution: stale review rejected; current source accepted without replay/rollback; original backup retained
resumedPublication: fresh batch succeeds; repeat resolution does not remove a new owner's lock
limitations: Explicit accept-current PoC; no product review UI or automatic unknown resolution
No dirty overlay restore or external-writer CAS
